escalation_note: ADDENDUM G2 (value overflows its printed column) OCCURRED ON BOTH SCHEDULES. A 900 dpi crop bounded on the amount column's own detected rules (82.47->92.24 on p2, 82.35->92.05 on p3) CLIPPED the last digit of both figures, rendering '605.2'. Re-rendered with the box widened to x=82.0 w=15.0, both cells render '605.20' in full. Each of the two transcribed rows therefore carries an EXPLICIT WIDENED geometry string, which wins over the page frame; the frames still record the honest measurement of the printed grid.

2.measure_note: legacy_colAB SCHEDULE A, underline form: rowbands.py returns 17 per-column rules 20.68->82.73 (4 segments each = Date / Name of Contributor / Mailing Address & Zip Code / Amount) at a regular pitch of 3.878. Text sits ABOVE its rule, so row N spans [rule N-1, rule N] and row 1 is extrapolated one pitch above rule 1 - 17 printed rules = 17 usable lines, of which the filer used only the first. TWO-CROP PROOF at 900 dpi: the row-1 box pct:82.47,16.80,9.77,3.88@p2 rendered the printed 'Amount' header over '605.2' - the figure OVERFLOWS the printed column (ADDENDUM G2) and the widened box pct:82.0,16.80,15.0,3.88@p2 rendered '605.20' in full, which is the geometry stored on the row. The ADDENDUM B5 one-past-the-end control pct:82.47,20.68,9.77,3.91@p2 rendered an EMPTY cell between two rules - the ledger really is one row, the filer did not skip line 1 (ADDENDUM A1 control passed), and trap F1.5 is ruled out.

3.measure_note: legacy_colAB SCHEDULE B, same underline form. rowbands.py returned only SIXTEEN rules here (26.50->84.64, pitch 3.876) because it missed the topmost rule, the one the single written row sits on; that rule was reconstructed at 26.50 - 3.876 = 22.62 and PROVED by crop. TWO-CROP PROOF at 900 dpi: the row-1 box pct:82.35,18.75,9.70,3.87@p3 rendered '605.2' - clipped by the printed column exactly as on p2 - and the widened box pct:82.0,18.75,15.0,3.87@p3 rendered '605.20' in full, which is the geometry stored on the row. The one-past-the-end control pct:82.35,22.62,9.70,3.88@p3 rendered an EMPTY cell, confirming the reconstructed top rule is in the right place and the ledger is one row.
